name: Bernadette Villeburg
original_name: ベルナデット＝ヴィルブルグ
source:
Bernadette is a princess from the Villeburg Kingdom. Though lower in the line of succession, she's the most active in regal duties among the Villeburg royals. She fully understands her role and responsibilities as an influential figure and doesn't mind them, but she's tired of being shadowed by bodyguards all the time.

She's intelligent and cunning, with plenty of initiative, but still has a childlike personality. Bernadette's emotions are an open book – she laughs when happy and pouts when upset. She's self-conscious about her small stature and, in an attempt to sound more dignified, picked up old-fashioned Japanese lordly language from period dramas, giving her speech a bit of a retro flair. She's visiting Shiromiya City for a specific reason...

Her hobbies include watching period dramas and strolls. She's got a thing for junk food, especially Japanese cup noodles, but she's not a fan of hotels - finds them too impersonal.

"As for myself, thou mayst call me Bel, a nickname it be. In turn, I shall address thee as Kaname."

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.akabeesoft3.com/products/koikishi/chara.html/]the official site[/url].]
